qualificationLimits: Current-host isolated installer identity and path; shortcuts omitted.
Older-version metadata simulated; not a genuine old-binary migration matrix.
Packaged UI ran serially using synthetic transcript, device and provider data; no real audio or external answer-provider request.
Speech inference used generated PCM, not recognition-quality or real installed-service qualification.
Dependency metadata describes the disclosed modified CPU-only and PCM-only distributions, not the unmodified upstream dependency graph.
Static PE closure and exercised loaded-module paths do not establish clean-VM or hardware-wide compatibility.
No recipient-side screen-sharing, universal capture exclusion, real shortcut-collision or owner-comfort qualification.
Published PDFs are immutable tagged-build editions; maintained repository documentation adds publication follow-up.
Unsigned; checksums identify bytes, not signer trust. Respect operating-system and organizational security controls.
